summary: Tested the app QR code, the app block in welcome/approval emails, app-install stats and nudges, and the 6-digit email sign-in code, on both backend and frontend. Backend: 13 of 13 pytest tests pass. Frontend: code sign-in works on /members (desktop) and /login (mobile); a staff user signed in with a code reached /admin. The Admin -> Members 'App installs' box works: count, progress bar, missing list, per-sister Nudge turning into 'Nudged', Nudge all, and the 'No one to nudge' toast on repeat. No functional bugs found.

minor.issue: The attempts check (find_one, then a separate $inc) is not atomic. Parallel wrong guesses could go past 5 tries on one code. The per-IP limit of 20 per 15 min caps the damage. Fix: use find_one_and_update with {attempts: {$lt: 5}} plus $inc, then compare the hash.

issues: The 'Nudge all' button stays enabled even when every missing sister was nudged in the last 7 days. Clicking it only shows 'No one to nudge right now'. Consider disabling it, or hiding it, when every missing sister was nudged recently.

design_issues.screen: Admin tab bar on mobile (390px), not part of this change
issues: The wrapped admin tab list sits inside a rounded-full white container, so it looks like an oval blob. Use rounded-2xl when it wraps.

action_items: Optional: make the code-verify attempts check atomic (find_one_and_update with attempts < 5)
Optional: disable 'Nudge all' when every missing sister was nudged within 7 days
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/qr/app.png encodes CANONICAL_SITE_URL + '/app' (https://caringsistersclub.org/app). The QR content could not be decoded (no pyzbar/cv2 installed); this was checked by reading the code. The PNG signature and content-type were checked.

_app_block_html uses PUBLIC_APP_URL for the /app link and the QR image. It is included in _welcome_html, in _send_approved_alert (passed as extra_html) and in the nudge email. Checked by calling the functions.

app-nudge sets app_nudged_at before the background email loop runs. send_email swallows errors (e.g. a 422 from the provider), so a failed send still counts as nudged for 7 days. This is acceptable, but staff get no signal when a send fails.
code-request deletes the user's old codes and inserts a new one. Rate limits: auth_code_req 5 per 15 min per IP, and 5 per hour per IP+email. Unknown emails get the same generic 200. Verified.
test_credentials: Temporary users only (test58_* and ui58_* @example.com). All were deleted afterwards, together with their sessions, auth_tokens and the rate_hits keys starting with auth_code or app-nudge.
seed_data_creation: None left behind. The preview DB had 0 active members before testing, so the all:true nudge only reached the temporary QA users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iter58_app_nudge_email_code.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. For UI: python tests/qa_iter58_ui.py up|code <6digits> [user_id]|down; admin cookie session_token=ui58_admin_tok. The code-request API replaces any code you inserted, so insert the known code AFTER clicking 'Email me a code'. The test skips all:true if real active un-installed members exist.
